entries.reviewSummary: Enacts the Small Employer Health Insurance Availability Act, defines thirty-five statutory terms, and incorporates undefined terms from section 376.450.

headings.title: Short title of small employer availability act
headings.reviewNote: Cites sections 379.930 to 379.952 as the Small Employer Health Insurance Availability Act.

headings.title: Definitions for small employer health insurance
headings.reviewNote: Defines actuarial certification, base premium rate, bona fide association, carrier, case characteristics, small employer, and health benefit plan.

headings.title: Incorporation of undefined terms from section 376.450
headings.reviewNote: Provides that other terms used in sections 379.930 to 379.952 not defined in subsection 2 have the same meaning as defined in section 376.450.

entries.reviewSummary: Sets employer-contribution and tax-treatment conditions for Small Employer Health Insurance Availability Act applicability, treats affiliated carriers as one carrier with an HMO exception, limits ceding arrangements, and exempts fully employee-paid plans.

headings.title: Conditions triggering applicability of small employer act
headings.reviewNote: Applies sections 379.930 to 379.952 to small employer health benefit plans when the employer pays or reimburses any portion of premiums/benefits or the plan is treated under Internal Revenue Code sections 162, 125, or 106.

headings.title: Affiliated carrier aggregation HMO exception and ceding limit
headings.reviewNote: Treats affiliated or consolidated-return carriers as one carrier (source note references S.B. 796, 1992 disposition), allows treating an affiliated HMO as a separate carrier, and bars ceding arrangements retaining less than 50% of risk without director authorization.

headings.title: Exemption for fully employee-paid health plans
headings.reviewNote: Exempts any plan or program where employees pay the total cost of the health benefit plan from sections 379.930 to 379.952.

entries.reviewSummary: Limits grounds for establishing classes of business for pre-March 23, 2010 small employer plans, caps separate classes at nine with transition rules, and authorizes director approval of additional classes.

headings.title: Permissible reasons to establish classes of business
headings.reviewNote: Restricts establishing a class of business for plans purchased on or before March 23, 2010, to substantial differences in expected claims or administrative costs from multiple marketing systems, acquired classes, or qualifying association groups.

headings.title: Nine-class limit and 1993 transition schedule
headings.reviewNote: Allows up to nine separate classes of business under subsection 1, with a three-year phase-down from twelve to nine classes for carriers with more than nine classes prior to July 1, 1993.

headings.title: Transition rules for acquired classes of business
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to promulgate transition-period rules for a carrier to comply with subsection 2 after acquiring an additional class of business from another small employer carrier.

headings.title: Director approval of additional classes of business
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to approve establishing additional classes of business upon application and a finding that it would enhance small employer marketplace efficiency and fairness.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates premium rate bands and case characteristics for pre-March 23, 2010 small employer plans, restricts class transfers, allows director rate-band suspensions, requires sales disclosures, and mandates rating records and annual actuarial certifications.

headings.title: Premium rate index and band restrictions
headings.reviewNote: Sets rate band, renewal cap, uniform-adjustment, industry-factor, case-characteristic, and rulemaking limits for plans purchased on or before March 23, 2010; source note indicates referenced sections 379.942 and 379.943 were repealed in 2007.

headings.title: Prohibition on involuntary or selective class transfers
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits involuntarily transferring a small employer into or out of a class of business and bars transfer offers unless made uniformly to all small employers in the class.

headings.title: Temporary director suspension of index rate band
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to suspend subsection 1(1) index rate band limits for specified rating periods upon carrier filing and findings of financial-condition reasonableness or marketplace efficiency and fairness.

headings.title: Required rating and renewability disclosures in sales materials
headings.reviewNote: Requires small employer carriers to disclose claims/health rating adjustments, rate-change provisions and factors, renewability provisions, and preexisting condition provisions in solicitation and sales materials.

headings.title: Rating documentation and March fifteenth actuarial certification
headings.reviewNote: Requires maintaining detailed rating and renewal underwriting documentation at the principal place of business, filing an annual actuarial certification by March fifteenth, and providing documentation to the director upon request.

entries.reviewSummary: Guarantees renewability of small employer health plans with enumerated exceptions, imposes a five-year market re-entry bar after full discontinuation, limits geographic area scope, and governs uniform renewal modifications and association plan sponsors.

headings.title: Renewable health benefit plans and nonrenewal exceptions
headings.reviewNote: Mandates guaranteed renewability at the small employer's option with nine enumerated exceptions, including nonpayment, fraud, participation/contribution noncompliance, network service area exit, 90-day product discontinuation, 180-day full market exit, association membership cessation, and director impairment findings.

headings.title: Five-year market re-entry bar after full discontinuation
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits a small employer carrier that discontinues all small employer health coverage under subsection 1(7) from writing new small employer business in Missouri for five years from notice to the director.

headings.title: Application limited to established geographic service area
headings.reviewNote: Limits the provisions of this section to the carrier's operations within its established geographic service area when doing business in one established service area.

headings.title: Uniform product coverage modification at annual renewal
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes uniform, law-compliant product coverage modifications at renewal (occurring no more often than annually on the effective-date anniversary unless a longer term is specified).

headings.title: Plan sponsor definition for bona fide association coverage
headings.reviewNote: Deems references to 'plan sponsor' in this section to include the small employer member for coverage made available only through one or more bona fide associations.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes guaranteed issue requirements for small employer health plans, regulating participation thresholds and capacity exemptions.

headings.title: Guaranteed issue of small employer health plans
headings.reviewNote: Requires small employer carriers to offer and issue health benefit plans to all eligible small employers applying for coverage.

headings.title: Uniform minimum employee participation and contribution rules
headings.reviewNote: Sets compliance, uniform minimum participation (100% for 3 or fewer, 75% for >3) and contribution rules, bars condition-specific riders, and allows retaining individual plans with cafeteria 125 contributions for plans purchased on or before March 23, 2010; source note indicates referenced section 379.953 does not exist.

headings.title: Service area and delivery network capacity limitations
headings.reviewNote: Relieves carriers of offering coverage outside established service areas or where network capacity is demonstrated inadequate.

headings.title: Temporary financial impairment relief from guaranteed issue
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to suspend guaranteed issue requirements if accepting new small employer cases would impair carrier solvency.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates active marketing of small group plans, bars health-based producer steering or commission cuts, and regulates third-party administrators.

headings.title: Active marketing of small employer health plans
headings.reviewNote: Requires small employer carriers to actively market all approved small group health plans to eligible small employers throughout the state.

headings.title: Prohibited discriminatory marketing practices by carriers
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits carriers, agents, and brokers from discouraging small employers from applying based on health status or claims experience.

headings.title: Prohibited commission variances based on health status
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits agent compensation arrangements that vary based on small employer claims history, industry, or employee health factors.

headings.title: Reasonable compensation for selling standard plans
headings.reviewNote: Requires carriers to pay reasonable compensation to agents and brokers for selling basic and standard small employer health plans.

headings.title: Retaliatory termination of agent contracts prohibited
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits carriers from terminating or limiting agency agreements based on the claims experience or health status of placed groups.

headings.title: Employee separation inducement prohibition and tobacco discounts
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits encouraging employers to exclude employees from group coverage, permitting non-tobacco wellness discounts.

headings.title: Written explanation requirement for coverage denials
headings.reviewNote: Requires small employer carriers to state the specific factual and legal grounds in writing for any denial of coverage.

headings.title: Administrative rulemaking for fair health plan marketing
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to promulgate administrative rules establishing fair marketing and availability standards for small group plans.

headings.title: Unfair trade practice classification and administrator scope
headings.reviewNote: Designates marketing violations as unfair trade practices under sections 375.930 to 375.949 (source note: section 375.949 was repealed in 1991) and subjects contracted third-party administrators to this section.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs mutual holding company formation, requiring director approval, majority policyholder votes, and mutual control of voting shares.

headings.title: Formation application and director review for reorganization
headings.reviewNote: Requires mutual insurers forming mutual holding companies to file reorganization applications, authorizing expert review and public hearings.

headings.title: Mandatory policyholder vote on reorganization plan
headings.reviewNote: Conditions reorganization on approval by a majority of voting policyholders at a special meeting, providing for policyholder mailings.

headings.title: Capital stock issuance and majority holding requirement
headings.reviewNote: Mandates that all voting shares of reorganized insurers be held by the mutual holding company, authorizing intermediate stock holding companies.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes membership rights in mutual holding companies, ensuring nontransferability, member non-liability, assessment bans, and securities exemptions.

headings.title: Transfer of member interests to mutual holding company
headings.reviewNote: Converts policyholder membership rights in the mutual insurer into membership interests in the new mutual holding company.

headings.title: Nontransferability of mutual holding company membership
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits members of mutual holding companies from transferring membership rights or interests to any other person.

headings.title: Member personal immunity from corporate liabilities
headings.reviewNote: Protects mutual holding company members from personal liability for the acts, debts, or obligations of the holding company.

headings.title: Prohibition of assessments upon holding company members
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits the imposition of any financial assessments upon mutual holding company members by directors or subsidiaries.

headings.title: Membership interest exemption from state securities laws
headings.reviewNote: Declares that a membership interest in a domestic mutual holding company does not constitute a security under state law.

entries.reviewSummary: Incorporates mutual holding companies under chapter 379, grants holding company powers while barring insurance underwriting, and authorizes mergers.

headings.title: Exemption from specific insurance holding company laws
headings.reviewNote: Exempts mutual holding company reorganizations and mergers from the provisions of sections 382.040, 382.060, and 382.095.

headings.title: Incorporation and approval of mutual holding company articles
headings.reviewNote: Requires incorporation under chapter 379 with articles approved by the insurance director and attorney general.

headings.title: Corporate powers and prohibition against insurance business
headings.reviewNote: Grants general corporate and holding company powers while prohibiting mutual holding companies from acting as insurers, authorizing mergers.

entries.reviewSummary: Subjects mutual holding companies to director supervision, protects policyholders during subsidiary insolvencies, and governs demutualization.

headings.title: Regulatory supervision and insolvency asset consolidation
headings.reviewNote: Subjects mutual holding companies to director supervision, consolidates holding assets into insolvent subsidiary estates, and bars unauthorized dissolution.

headings.title: Demutualization procedures and statutory scope
headings.reviewNote: Applies statutory demutualization provisions to mutual holding companies and restricts application to for-profit property and casualty insurers.
